title: CupBox
description: This resourcepack adds a Re-texture of the minecraft pumpkin and the carved pumpkin as a Cardboard box
body:
1. **_Hello friends!
1. 
1. As my first ever Released item on this Website, after a day of careful design-making, deciding with my friends and Collecting, and sanding, and sanding and collecting... 
1. _**

```
Introducing..!
THE CUPBOX!
```


_"BUT CUPP?!?! WHAT IS CUPBOX YOU FUC-"_

a.... its a resource pack, why of course!
this resourcepack adds a re-texture of the two pumpkins in the game.
The carved pumpkin, which you can wear is Cuptoast's redesigned catface! of course its a little inaccurate, but i did my best!
The normal pumpkin is just an average closed cardboard box.

Now why did i make this??
Well many reason but mostly because i am a huge fan of cuptoast, and i have atleast 33 cardboard boxes in my little workshop about different variations.
and because well.. minecraft is technically about endless possibilites, meaning you dont always have to wear that DAFTY little pumpkin!

Anyway, cheers,![:3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4197da0dc303ce668a4b93fd650f31ca8a8363b_0.webp) Friends!
